description: Thin, fail-open retrieval and session-summary hooks for fff-memory

hooks.prompt:
Review $ARGUMENTS. Only when mcp__plugin_fff-memory_fff-memory__memory_store is already allowed, call memory_store at most once for substantive decisions or discoveries not already stored, with type session-summary and 2–6 future-question aliases; otherwise skip and fail open.
Never store secrets or routine activity. Return {"ok":true} after storing or skipping.
